verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair capability to ask of small-business accounting software, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only rule-based automation: auto-categorized bank transactions, scheduled overdue reminders, recurring invoices and OCR receipt extraction. None of these is an AI assistant a user can delegate tasks to, so they are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
